kpop-tracker v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- All-in-one K-Pop idol tracker supporting comebacks, albums, concerts, merchandise, YouTube, and solo activities.
- Supports multi-group tracking with automated cron checks and detailed output in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文).
- Special features include album benefits comparison, signed album alerts (IVE), and price analysis for all major stores.
- Structured, category-based update reports with strict output format for easy idol schedule tracking.
- Flexible config and management for tracked artists and their official/fan sources.
